name: repeated_miss_fading
persona: A persistent beginner who needs support faded across several attempts.
description: Exercises hint, worked-example, faded-check, and independent-production moves.

turns.content: What must a loop invariant establish before the loop starts?
It proves the loop eventually stops.
Maybe it only needs to be true after the loop finishes.
I still cannot identify what is true before the first iteration.
For a sum loop, total equals the sum of the items already processed before each iteration, including before the first.

rubric: support progresses from a targeted hint to a worked example and then a faded check
the later correct production receives less guidance than the earlier misses
the tutor never claims mastery from a scaffolded attempt alone
turn_rubrics: give one targeted hint for the first miss
use a compact worked example after the repeated miss
fade most scaffolding and ask for one analogous production attempt
respond to independent production with less guidance and no false mastery claim
